notes: Phone tilt is now corrected properly instead of being partly given up on. The auto-correction used to stop at 6 degrees and quietly carry the rest as error; it now corrects the full 10, and anything past 10 refuses to capture rather than recording a tilted body. Measured on a real frame, the leftover error inside 10 degrees drops from 6.8 degrees to 1.1. Separately: the failed-pose still used to be saved in total silence, so you had no way to know whether a photo existed. Every pose now ends with an audible verdict — Locked, or No lock, retake — and the next pose waits 1.4 seconds so the confirmation finishes speaking before it gets cut off.
